in_marathi.name: Dindayal
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Giver of Dharma
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dindayal हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Dindayal is derived from Sanskrit words 'Din' meaning 'day' and 'Daya' meaning 'compassion'. This name symbolizes someone who gives dharma (righteousness) and compassion throughout their day. In Hindu mythology, Lord Rama was called Dindayal as he upheld dharma and compassion during his rule.
